en.body: Cambridge Hospital delivered a Stress and Time Management Workshop for employees across different departments. The sessions provided practical guidance on managing work and personal pressures, improving productivity and establishing healthier daily habits, with the broader aim of supporting mental well-being and a more balanced professional life.
